d: Short, choppy chocolate-brown hair with messy bangs and a small bun. Large, wide-set light blue eyes with a playful, smiling expression on a youthful, mature face. Slender build, wearing a white short-sleeved polo shirt with navy and red accents, a navy ID lanyard, black athletic shorts with red trim, and a navy jacket tied around the waist. Accessories include a red headset with a microphone, black fingerless gloves, dark navy crew socks, and navy sneakers with white soles.
